PFAS-free options

Match the claim to the finished construction

Applicable PFAS-free paper options can be discussed after the base paper, treatment, coating, ink, converting method and intended use are defined. Available declarations or testing should be checked against the exact approved specification.

Review the PFAS-free program →

Food-contact safety

Review available support by market and product

Available FDA-related, EU food-contact, LFGB, BfR or DGCCRF documentation may support buyer review when its sample, material, test conditions and validity align with the proposed product. Availability is not a blanket certification of every item.
